sources.title: MoriyaResearchInstitute/Miracle-1.5-FlashNano · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Miracle FlashNano is a 108M parameter dense language model. The model architecture is a 16-layer GQA Transformer with hidden size 768, 12 query heads, 4 key/value heads, head dimension 64, and a 1,536-dimensional SwiGLU. Layers 8 and 16 use global causal attention; the other 14 layers use an 8,192-token causal sliding window.

sources.snippet: GLM is the flagship model series of Z.ai, one of the six AI tigers of China. The weights of most GLM models are released under the MIT License or Apache License 2.0, allowing them to be run either locally or in the cloud.
